mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE CODE_HIERARCHY AS ( SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.CODE_ID, C.UPPER_CODE_ID, C.USE_FL, C.CODE_LANG_KEY, CAST(C.CODE_ID AS CHAR(5000)) AS PATH, 1 AS `LEVEL` FROM CM_CODE C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.UPPER_CODE_ID = '#' UNION ALL SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.CODE_ID, C.UPPER_CODE_ID, C.USE_FL, C.CODE_LANG_KEY, CAST(CONCAT(CH.PATH, '>', C.CODE_ID) AS CHAR(5000)) AS PATH, CH.`LEVEL` + 1 AS `LEVEL` FROM CM_CODE C INNER JOIN CODE_HIERARCHY CH ON C.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND C.UPPER_CODE_ID = CH.CODE_ID ) SELECT CH.CODE_ID AS codeId, IFNULL(B.MESSAGE_CN, CH.CODE_ID) AS name, CH.UPPER_CODE_ID AS upperCodeId, CH.USE_FL AS useFl, CH.PATH AS path, CH.`LEVEL` AS level FROM CODE_HIERARCHY CH LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND B.LANG_KEY = CH.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} ORDER BY CH.PATH

SELECT C_UPPER.CODE_ID AS upperCodeId, M_UPPER.MESSAGE_CN AS upperCodeName, C.CODE_ID AS codeId, M.MESSAGE_CN AS codeName, C.USE_FL AS useFl, C.CODE_CN AS codeCn, M.LANG_KEY AS codeLangKey FROM CM_CODE C LEFT JOIN CM_CODE C_UPPER ON C_UPPER.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND C_UPPER.CODE_ID = C.UPPER_CODE_ID LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG M ON M.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND M.LANG_KEY = C.CODE_LANG_KEY AND M.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG M_UPPER ON M_UPPER.CMPNY_CD = C_UPPER.CMPNY_CD AND M_UPPER.LANG_KEY = C_UPPER.CODE_LANG_KEY AND M_UPPER.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.CODE_ID = #{codeId}

SELECT B.MESSAGE_CN AS codeName, A.DETAIL_CODE_ID AS detailCodeId, A.DETAIL_CODE_VALUE AS detailCodeValue, A.USE_FL AS useFl, A.SORTING_SQ AS sortingSq, A.CODE_LANG_KEY AS codeLangKey FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.CODE_ID = #{codeId} ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'X' WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'O' END AS result FROM CM_CODE WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND UPPER_CODE_ID = #{codeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_CODE ( CMPNY_CD, CODE_ID, UPPER_CODE_ID, CODE_LANG_KEY, USE_FL, CODE_CN, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{codeId}, #{upperCodeId}, #{codeLangKey}, #{useFl}, #{codeCn}, #{creationId}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO CM_CODE_DETAIL ( CMPNY_CD, CODE_ID, DETAIL_CODE_ID, DETAIL_CODE_VALUE, CODE_LANG_KEY, SORTING_SQ, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{codeId}, #{detailCodeId}, #{detailCodeValue}, #{codeLangKey}, #{sortingSq}, #{useFl}, #{creationId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_CODE SET USE_FL = #{useFl}, CODE_CN = #{codeCn}, CODE_LANG_KEY = #{codeLangKey}, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND CODE_ID = #{codeId}
